name: Dynamic iceLand
description:
A Dynamic Island for GNOME that sits at the top of the screen and springs open on hover.

• Music from any player: cover art, scrolling titles, real-time audio visualizer (with cava), seek bar you can drag, shuffle and repeat
• Colours that follow the album art
• Volume and brightness pop-ups in place of GNOME's
• Charger, low battery, Bluetooth devices, Caps Lock
• Notification previews
• Screen recording timer and download progress, with a side bubble while music plays
• Scroll for volume or tracks, middle-click to play/pause, right-click for settings
• Over 60 settings
